def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; original=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c] not in (0,1)}
    objs=[]
    while pts:
        stack=[pts.pop()]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            p=stack.pop();comp.append(p)
            near=[q for q in pts if abs(q[0]-p[0])<=2 and abs(q[1]-p[1])<=2]
            for q in near: pts.remove(q);stack.append(q)
        objs.append(comp)
    for obj in objs:
        colors=Counter(original[r][c] for r,c in obj)
        center=colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
        centerpts=[p for p in obj if original[p[0]][p[1]]==center]
        cr=sum(r for r,c in centerpts)/len(centerpts);cc=sum(c for r,c in centerpts)/len(centerpts)
        spreads=[abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in centerpts for r2,c2 in centerpts if abs(r1-r2)==1 and c1!=c2]
        scale=min(spreads) if spreads else 2
        for color in colors:
            if color==center:continue
            ps=[p for p in obj if original[p[0]][p[1]]==color]
            groups=[]
            for vertical in ([p for p in ps if p[0]<cr],[p for p in ps if p[0]>cr]):
                if not vertical:continue
                left=[p for p in vertical if p[1]<cc];right=[p for p in vertical if p[1]>cc]
                groups.extend([q for q in (left,right) if q])
            for side in groups:
                ar=sum(r for r,c in side)/len(side);ac=sum(c for r,c in side)/len(side)
                sr=1 if ar>cr else -1;sc=1 if ac>cc else -1
                for r,c in (min(side),max(side)):
                    r+=sr;c+=scale*sc
                    while 0<=r<R and 0<=c<C:
                        if g[r][c] in (0,1):g[r][c]=color
                        r+=sr;c+=scale*sc
    return g
